name: To the Müggelsee shore
summary: One way from Köpenick to the Seglergemeinschaft am Müggelsee on the lake shore. Mostly sealed, with a stretch of soft path.
notes: Built from OpenStreetMap and a terrain model between the shared start and the furthest point of a walk the testers do regularly. The way they actually walk may differ; a GPS recording would replace this version.
Starts about 600 m along the usual route rather than at the door: walks are shown to every beta tester and kept in the project's public repository, so none begins at anyone's home.
A walk to a destination: plan the way back separately.

sources.label: EU-DEM 25 m terrain model via Open Topo Data
sources.attribution: Produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union - EU-DEM layers
sources.limitation: 25 m grid: sustained slopes only; short ramps and kerbs are not visible, and buildings or trees can distort values in town.
